statBlock.name: Agdon Longscarf
statBlock.speed: 35 ft., or 70 ft. with his scarf
statBlock.description: A boastful harengon brigand with an enchanted blue scarf. Zybilna pinned him to a tree by it. Bavlorna freed him in exchange for the best item taken from each victim.

sections.Traits:
Evasion. When a Dexterity save would halve damage, Agdon instead takes none on a success or half on a failure. This trait has no effect while he is incapacitated.
Standing Leap. Agdon can long jump up to 20 ft. or high jump up to 10 ft. without needing a running start.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two attacks, choosing Branding Iron or Dagger for each.
Branding Iron. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. On a hit, deal 10 (3d6) fire damage and magically brand the target. Agdon is invisible to creatures bearing his brand. The mark lasts 24 hours unless removed sooner by a spell that ends a curse. The iron cools when he lets go of it and works only for him.
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d4 + 5) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Quick Fingers. Target a creature Agdon can see within 5 ft. Roll Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) against DC 1 + its passive Perception. On a success, he steals one object of 1 lb. or less that it carries but does not have in hand. It does not notice the theft.
sections.Reactions: Uncanny Dodge. When an attack hits Agdon, halve its damage if he can see the attacker.
sections.Encounter context: Agdon and his Harengon Brigands ambush travelers at the Brigands’ Tollway, with Harengon Snipers in support. A creature can use an action and succeed on a DC 17 Strength (Athletics) check to catch Agdon’s scarf. While it holds the scarf, his speed is 35 ft. and he cannot move more than 15 ft. from it. He can try once to pull free as an action, resolved by a contested Strength (Athletics) check. If he loses, he surrenders on the spot. The scarf cannot be removed, even if Agdon dies.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 72–74. Stat block on p. 73.

statBlock.name: Alagarthas
statBlock.description: An elf prince stranded in Yon after making a bargain with Endelyn Moongrave. He wants to return to the Misty Forest to face the green dragon threatening his kingdom.

sections.Traits:
Brave. Alagarthas has advantage on saves against being frightened.
Fey Ancestry. He has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put him to sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks.
Unarmed Strike. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 bludgeoning damage.
Leadership (recharges after a short or long rest). For 1 minute, when Alagarthas sees a nonhostile creature within 30 ft. make an attack roll or saving throw, he can call out a command or warning. The creature can add 1d4 if it hears and understands him. Only one Leadership die can apply to a roll. The effect ends early if Alagarthas becomes incapacitated.
sections.Encounter context: The Fey Beacons show the route home only if Alagarthas lights all eight himself. It takes him 8 hours once the Perytons stop snuffing them out. Their flock was once a troupe of actors that performed for Endelyn Moongrave.
sections.Printing note: The adventure applies changes to the 2014 Knight. Alagarthas starts unarmed, so he uses an unarmed strike for 1 + Strength modifier damage and cannot use Parry. If he later wields a melee weapon and can see an attacker that would hit him with a melee attack, he can use the base Knight’s Parry reaction to add 2 AC against that attack.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 144. Base Knight on p. 347 of the 2014 Monster Manual.

statBlock.name: Amidor the Dandelion
statBlock.description: A sword-wielding dandelion who speaks in verse and helps travelers find their way in Yon. Its beloved companion is Pollenella the Honeybee.

sections.Traits: Speak with Beasts and Plants. Amidor can converse with Beasts and Plants as though it shares a language with them.
sections.Actions:
Rapier. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.
Seed Sling. Ranged weapon attack, +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Reactions: Parry. Add 2 to Amidor’s AC against one melee attack about to hit it. Amidor must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.
sections.Encounter context: The party meets Amidor, Pollenella, and the masked elf acrobat Gleam during the journey through Yon. Use Selenelion Twin for Gleam. Amidor is quick to fall in love, puts others first, and tends to guard Pollenella rather than take the lead in a fight.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 134–135 and Appendix D. Stat block on p. 135.

statBlock.name: Bavlorna Blightstraw
statBlock.description: Slack-jawed Lorna bargains for immediate relief from other people’s troubles. The hag of the present distrusts visitors and relies on diminutive copies of herself in her Downfall cottage.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. Bavlorna breathes air and water.
Boon of Immortality. Aging has no effect on her, and old age cannot kill her.
Widdershins Allergy. If a creature within 10 ft. spends at least 10 ft. of movement running in place counterclockwise, Bavlorna starts sneezing and cannot cast spells through the end of her next turn. Any creature she has swallowed is expelled at once into an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of her and falls prone.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Use Bite once and Withering Ray once.
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Deal 13 (2d6 + 6) piercing damage on a hit. A Medium or smaller target is also grappled (escape DC 16) and restrained until the grapple ends. Bavlorna cannot Bite another target while holding this one.
Withering Ray. Ranged spell attack, +6 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Deal 17 (4d6 + 3) necrotic damage on a hit.
Create Lornlings (Recharge 5–6). Create one or two 1-ft.-tall duplicates in unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. Each obeys Bavlorna and acts immediately after her. Use the Quickling stat block. Each lasts 1 hour, until it or Bavlorna dies, or until Bavlorna dismisses it as an action. No more than eight can exist at once.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Intelligence (spell save DC 14), without material components.
At will. Detect Magic.
2/day each. Create Food and Water, Polymorph, Remove Curse.
1/day. Plane Shift (self only).
sections.Bonus actions: Swallow. Swallow a Small or smaller creature that Bavlorna is grappling, ending that grapple. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and effects from outside her, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. If this damage reduces a lornling to 0 HP, Bavlorna gains its memories. Only one creature can be swallowed at a time. If she dies, the swallowed creature is no longer restrained and can spend 5 ft. of movement to leave her corpse, emerging prone.
sections.Hourglass Coven: When Bavlorna, Endelyn Moongrave, and Skabatha Nightshade are all within 30 ft. of one another, any one can spend an action to cast Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Finger of Death, Glibness, Locate Creature, or Mass Suggestion without material components (spell save DC 14). Once any sister casts one of these shared spells, the whole coven loses access to that spell until the next dawn.
sections.Encounter context: Bavlorna must spend an hour submerged in brine each day. Without it she dries out and her body eventually locks up until she is submerged again. She uses a Bobbing Lily Pad to travel from her cottage, accompanied by lornlings. Witchlight’s appendix C uses the Quickling whose Blurred Movement ends when it is incapacitated or its speed becomes 0.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, pp. 215–216 and 239. Stat block on p. 216.

printing.publication: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse

statBlock.name: Brigganock
statBlock.description: A mouse-sized Feywild miner with its soul floating outside its body as a little light. Brigganocks pull wish stones from the earth and use bursts of accelerated time to finish jobs.

sections.Traits:
Fey Ancestry. The brigganock has advantage on saves against being charmed, and magic cannot put it to sleep.
Soul Light. A tangible body does not contain this brigganock’s soul. It travels alongside the creature as an invulnerable, insubstantial light. It sheds bright light out to 10 ft. and dim light for another 10 ft. The brigganock cannot switch it off or adjust it. It fades when the brigganock dies.
Tunneler. With a pickaxe or similar tool, the brigganock can burrow through solid rock at 5 ft., leaving a 6-inch-wide tunnel.
sections.Actions:
Pickaxe. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
Time Lapse (recharges after a short or long rest). Finish up to 1 hour of work in seconds within a 10-ft. cube. The work can affect the brigganock and unattended objects, but no other creature or any object worn or carried by one.
sections.Spellcasting:
As an action, cast a listed spell using Charisma (spell save DC 11), without material components.
At will. Minor Illusion, Spare the Dying.
1/day each. Animal Friendship, Faerie Fire, Meld into Stone, Silence.
sections.Bonus actions: Move Soul Light. Move the light up to 30 ft. in any direction to an unoccupied space the brigganock can see. It returns at the end of the current turn.
sections.Encounter context: A mortal’s nonmagical wish can leave an echo inside a stone deep in the Feywild. Brigganocks keep and cut stones with kindly wishes and discard malicious ones. Powerful fey can use a wish stone to scry on the person who wished, power a supernatural charm, or awaken an animated object.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 230.

statBlock.name: Bullywug Knight
statBlock.description: A plate-clad champion of the Soggy Court. Bullywug knights insist that both sides fight fairly. Morgort, the imprisoned Knight of Warts in Downfall, is one example.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The knight breathes air and water.
Speak with Frogs and Toads. When speaking Bullywug, it can communicate simple ideas to frogs and toads.
Standing Leap. It can long jump up to 20 ft. or high jump up to 10 ft. without a running start.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Glaive attacks.
Glaive. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage.
sections.Bonus actions: Croak of Charming (recharges after a short or long rest). Target one creature the knight can see within 30 ft. The knight croaks loudly. The target must pass a DC 12 Wisdom save or become charmed through the end of its next turn.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 231.

statBlock.name: Campestri
statBlock.description: A salt-loving mushroom creature with a spotted red or purple cap. It joins any tune it hears in a nasal falsetto, even when the performance is dreadful.

sections.Languages: Understands Common but speaks only through the use of its Mimicry trait.
sections.Traits: Mimicry. Reproduce any voice or song the campestri has heard, in its own nasal falsetto.
sections.Actions:
Head Butt. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 1 bludgeoning damage.
Spores (1/day). Release spores in a 5-ft. radius around the campestri. They spread around corners and do not affect Constructs, Elementals, Plants, or Undead. Every other creature in the area makes a DC 10 Wisdom save. On a failure, it is incapacitated and its speed halves for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending both effects on a success.
sections.Encounter context: A campestri remembers a song after three or four rehearsals. Several may sing and dance together. Use Swarm of Campestris for an attacking group.
sections.Printed source: The Wild Beyond the Witchlight, p. 232.
